youtube.aciklama: Threshold is not a sharp boundary; around threshold, a sound is sometimes heard and sometimes not. Threshold is usually defined as the 50 percent point of the psychometric function; in the clinic, it is the lowest level at which the sound is heard on at least half of the trials. So a difference of about 5 decibels between repeated measurements in the same person is common, and repeating the measurement is more reliable for borderline thresholds.
